name: Mack MP8 2010-2013 Fault Code Reference
source: Diesel Laptops / Diesel Repair - Mack MP8 (2010-2013) Fault Code List
usage_note: Curated retrieval reference based only on the supplied Diesel Repair source. Preserve SPN and FMI together. The source describes the 2010-2013 Mack MP8 as 12.8L, 415-505 HP, up to 1,860 lb-ft, SCR + DPF, common rail, used in Pinnacle, Granite and other Class 8 applications. This is a fault-code meaning reference, not an OEM troubleshooting procedure; verify current Mack service information before parts replacement.

documents.title: Mack MP8 2010-2013 engine and fault-code scope
documents.summary: Diesel Repair identifies the 2010-2013 Mack MP8 as a 12.8L heavy-duty engine rated 415-505 HP and up to 1,860 lb-ft, with common-rail fuel injection and SCR + DPF emissions equipment, used in Mack Pinnacle, Granite and other Class 8 applications.

documents.title: Mack MP8 2010-2013 oil and cooling fault families
documents.summary: Source-listed MP8 families include SPN100 engine oil pressure with FMI 1,13,15,17,3,5; SPN98 engine oil level with FMI 1,18,4,5; SPN175 engine oil temperature with FMI 0,13,16,17,2,4,5; SPN110 coolant temperature with FMI 0,10,13,16,17,2,4,5; and SPN111 coolant level with FMI 1,14,18,3,4,5. Interpret the exact FMI rather than treating all faults for one SPN as the same failure.

documents.title: Mack MP8 2010-2013 intake turbo and EGR faults
documents.summary: The source lists SPN102 intake manifold pressure across FMI 12,13,14,15,17,2,3,5; SPN103 turbocharger speed FMI 0,1,15,17,9; SPN105 intake manifold temperature FMI 0,13,17,2,4,5; SPN108 barometric pressure FMI 2,3,4; SPN2629 turbo compressor outlet temperature; SPN3675 turbo compressor bypass valve position FMI 3,4,5,7; SPN411 EGR differential pressure FMI 0,1,2,3,5,7; SPN412 EGR temperature; and SPN641 VGT actuator 1 FMI 13,2,4,7,9 plus SPN642 VGT actuator 2 conditions.

documents.title: Mack MP8 2010-2013 injector and misfire faults
documents.summary: The source includes SPN1322 FMI31 multiple-cylinder misfire condition and FMI8 abnormal frequency/pulse-width/period. Injector faults include SPN651 cylinder 1 with FMI 13,3,31,5,7,8; SPN652 cylinder 2 with the same listed FMI family; and SPN653 cylinder 3 entries including FMI 13,3,31,5,7. These descriptions identify fault categories but do not by themselves establish that an injector must be replaced.

documents.title: Mack MP8 2010-2013 DPF and aftertreatment faults
documents.summary: Source-listed aftertreatment families include SPN3249 DPF intake temperature FMI 2,4,5; SPN3250 DPF intermediate gas temperature FMI 1,10,11,13,14; SPN3522 aftertreatment total fuel used FMI 1,16,18; SPN3556 hydrocarbon doser FMI 13,14,3,4,5; SPN3597 DPF regeneration FMI 3,4,5; and SPN3695 FMI9 DPF switch / MP8 engine abnormal update rate.

documents.title: Mack MP8 2010-2013 network and electronic faults
documents.summary: Network/electronic entries in the supplied list include SPN1231 SAE J1939 Data Link 2 FMI2 and FMI9; SPN2003 FMI9 TCM status; SPN2017 FMI9 cruise-control status; SPN2029 FMI8/FMI9 invalid or missing vehicle ECU data; SPN228 speed-sensor calibration FMI11/FMI9; SPN237 VIN FMI12/FMI2; SPN245 total vehicle distance FMI9; SPN251 time FMI10,12,13,19,2,9; and SPN252 date FMI9. For network faults, investigate communication/power/network context rather than assuming the named module is failed.

documents.title: Mack MP8 2010-2013 crankcase engine brake and fan faults
documents.summary: The source lists SPN153 high-resolution crankcase pressure with FMI 0,13,15,17,2,3,5; SPN1072 compression-brake output #1 FMI 1,3,4,5; SPN1265 piston-cooling oil-pressure actuator FMI 3,4,5 (SID 85 shown); and SPN647 engine fan-clutch output driver FMI 3,4,5 (SID 33 shown).

documents.title: Mack MP8 2010-2013 temperature and environmental sensor faults
documents.summary: The supplied list includes SPN171 ambient-air-temperature FMI 13,14,19,2,9; SPN173 exhaust-gas-temperature FMI 0,15,16,2,4,5; and SPN1136 ECM temperature FMI4/FMI5. FMI meaning matters: network-data, calibration, circuit and measured-condition faults require different diagnostic paths.

documents.title: Panta rule for Mack MP8 2010-2013 fault lookup
documents.summary: For a 2010-2013 Mack MP8 question, match the complete SPN + FMI from the source and retain the engine/model-year context. Report the source-listed component/parameter and failure-mode meaning first. Do not infer an OEM troubleshooting tree, connector pin, resistance specification or replacement instruction when the supplied source only provides a code title. Recommend OEM service information when exact test procedures are required.
